description_en: Queries the attribute information of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-db-cluster-attribute --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000000 --describe-type AI --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html接口查看账号下所有集群的详细信息，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to retrieve AI-related node information
parameters.help_zh: 是否获取AI相关节点信息
parameters.name: describe_type

AiCreatingTime.description_en: The start time of the free AI feature

AiType.description_en: The AI node type. Valid values:
AiType.description_zh:
AI节点类型。取值范围如下：
     
SearchNode：搜索节点。
DLNode：AI节点

Architecture.description_zh:
CPU 架构。取值范围如下：
X86
ARM

AutoUpgradeMinorVersion.description_zh:
小版本升级方式

Auto：自动升级
Manual：手动升级

BlktagTotal.description_en: The maximum number of blktags in the file system

BurstingEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether I/O performance burst is enabled for the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values:
BurstingEnabled.description_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘是否开启IO性能突发。取值：

true：开启
false：关闭

Category.description_en:
The [product edition]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html）. Valid values:
Normal: Cluster Edition
Basic: Single Node Edition
Archive: PolarDB X-Engine Edition
NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster Edition
SENormal: PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition

PolarDB for PostgreSQL 11 does not support Single Node Edition.
PolarDB for MySQL 8.0, PolarDB for MySQL 5.7, and PolarDB for PostgreSQL 14 support PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition.
PolarDB for MySQL 8.0 supports PolarDB X-Engine Edition and Multi-master Cluster Edition
Category.description_zh:
[产品系列]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html），取值范围如下：
Normal：集群版
Basic：单节点
Archive：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）
NormalMultimaster：多主架构集群版
SENormal：标准版

PolarDB PostgreSQL版PostgreSQL 11版本不支持单节点。
PolarDB MySQL版8.0版本、5.7版本，PolarDB PostgreSQL版PostgreSQL 14版本支持标准版。
PolarDB MySQL版8.0版本，支持高压缩引擎（X-Engine）和多主架构集群版

ColumnTable.description_en: Indicates whether the column store table is enabled

CompressStorageMode.description_en: Indicates whether storage compression is enabled. Valid values:
CompressStorageMode.description_zh:
是否为开启存储压缩。取值范围如下：
ON：开启
OFF：关闭

CompressStorageUsed.description_en: The size of the storage data after compression
CompressStorageUsed.description_zh:
压缩后的存储数据大小。
仅当集群开启存储压缩功能后支持返回该参数

ConnectionResourceQuota.description_zh: 连接资源数配额（AgenticDB 专属）
ConnectionResourceQuota.title_zh: 连接资源数配额（AgenticDB 专属）

ConnectionResourceUsed.description_en: The number of connection resources used (AgenticDB exclusive)
ConnectionResourceUsed.description_zh: 已使用连接资源数（AgenticDB 专属）
ConnectionResourceUsed.title_zh: 已使用连接资源数（AgenticDB 专属）

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type of the cluster

DBClusterStatus.description_en: The cluster status. For more information, see [Cluster status table]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html）
DBClusterStatus.description_zh: 集群状态，取值范围请参见[集群状态表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99286.html）

AddedCpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores added by automatically scaling local resources

CpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the node

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the node was created

DBNodeRole.description_en: The role of the node. Valid values:
DBNodeRole.description_zh:
节点角色，取值范围如下： 

Writer：主节点。
Reader：只读节点。

DBNodeStatus.description_en: The status of the node. Valid values:
DBNodeStatus.description_zh:
节点状态，取值范围如下：
Creating：创建中 
Running：运行中 
Deleting：删除中  
Rebooting：重启中  
DBNodeCreating：正在增加节点  
DBNodeDeleting：正在删除节点 
ClassChanging：正在变更节点规格  
NetAddressCreating：正在创建网络连接  
NetAddressDeleting：正在删除网络连接  
NetAddressModifying：正在修改网络连接
MinorVersionUpgrading：小版本升级中
Maintaining：实例维护中  
Switching：切换中

FailoverPriority.description_en:
The failover priority. Each node has a failover priority that determines the probability of the node being elected as the primary node during a failover. A larger value indicates a higher priority.
Valid values: 1 to 15
FailoverPriority.description_zh:
Failover优先级。每个节点都有一个Failover优先级，决定了当故障切换时，该节点被选举为主节点的概率高低。数值越大，优先级越高。
取值范围为1~15

HotReplicaMode.description_en: Indicates whether hot standby is enabled. Valid values:
HotReplicaMode.description_zh:
是否开启热备。取值范围如下：

ON：开启

OFF：关闭

ImciSwitch.description_en: Indicates whether In-Memory Column Index is enabled. Valid values:
ImciSwitch.description_zh:
是否开启列存索引。取值范围如下：

ON：开启

OFF：关闭

MasterId.description_en: The primary node ID of the Multi-master Cluster Edition
MasterId.description_zh: 多主架构集群版的主节点ID

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent connections to the cluster

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum number of I/O requests per second (IOPS)

MemorySize.description_en: The memory size of the node. Unit: MB

MirrorInsName.description_en: The name of the hot replica that corresponds to the node in the hot standby storage and compute architecture
MirrorInsName.description_zh: 开启存储热备和计算热备架构中，节点对应的计算热备节点名

Orca.description_zh:
Orca功能，取值范围如下：

on：开启

off: 关闭

RemoteMemorySize.description_en: The remote memory size. Unit: MB

SccMode.description_en: Indicates whether the global consistency (high-performance mode) feature is enabled for the node. Valid values:
SccMode.description_zh:
节点是否开启全局一致性（高性能模式）功能。取值范围如下：

ON：开启

OFF：关闭

ServerWeight.description_zh:
路由权重。
取值范围：1~100。默认值为1

ServerlessType.description_en:
The serverless type of the node. Valid values:

AgileServerless: agile serverless. The node is a serverless node.
SteadyServerless: steady serverless. The node is a node with defined specifications that has the serverless feature enabled.

This parameter is supported only for serverless clusters or clusters with defined specifications that have the serverless feature enabled. For more information, see [Serverless]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452274.html）
ServerlessType.description_zh:
节点的Serverless类型。取值范围如下：

AgileServerless：敏态，即Serverless节点。
SteadyServerless：稳态，即在固定规格节点上叠加了Serverless能力。

仅在Serverless集群或开启了Serverless功能的固定规格集群，才支持该参数。详细说明，请参见[Serverless]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/452274.html）

SubCluster.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is in the primary zone or the secondary zone. This parameter is mainly used for resource-symmetric deployments.

Valid values:
Primary: primary zone.
Standby: secondary zone
SubCluster.description_zh:
查看节点是在主可用区还是备可用区，主要是资源对等形态在用。
取值范围如下：
Primary：主可用区
Standby：备可用区

DBVersionStatus.description_en:
The status of the current minor version. Valid values:
Stable: The current version is stable.
Old: The current version is outdated. Upgrade to the latest version.
HighRisk: The current version has critical defects. Upgrade to the latest version immediately.
Beta: The current version is a Beta version.

For more information about how to upgrade the minor version, see [Version upgrade]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158572.html）.
This parameter is returned only when the database engine type (DBType) is MySQL
DBVersionStatus.description_zh:
当前数据库小版本状态，取值范围如下：
Stable：当前版本状态稳定。
Old：当前版本过旧，建议升级到最新版本。
HighRisk：当前版本有严重缺陷，请立即升级到最新的版本。
Beta：当前版本为 Beta 版。

关于如何升级数据库小版本，请参见[版本升级]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158572.html）。
仅当数据库引擎类型（DBType）为MySQL时，返回当前参数

DataLevel1BackupChainSize.description_en: The total size of level-1 backups (snapshots). Unit: bytes
DataLevel1BackupChainSize.description_zh: 一级备份（快照）总大小，单位为Byte

DataSyncMode.description_en:
The data replication mode. Valid values:
AsyncSync: asynchronous
SemiSync: semi-synchronous
DataSyncMode.description_zh:
数据复制关系模式。取值范围如下：
AsyncSync：异步
SemiSync：半同步

DeletionLock.description_en:
The lock status of cluster deletion. Valid values:
0: Unlocked. The cluster can be deleted.
1: Locked. The cluster cannot be deleted
DeletionLock.description_zh:
集群删除的锁定状态，取值范围如下：
0：未锁定，可删除集群。
1：锁定，不可删除集群

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster.

Only clusters whose billing method is Prepaid (subscription) return a specific value for this parameter. Postpaid (pay-as-you-go) clusters return an empty value
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群到期时间。

仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群会返回具体参数值，Postpaid（按量付费）集群则返回空值。

Expired.description_en: Indicates whether the cluster has expired
Expired.description_zh:
集群是否到期。
仅付费方式为Prepaid（包年包月）的集群支持返回该参数

HasCompleteStandbyRes.description_en:
Indicates whether resources for the new primary database are replenished after a cross-zone failover. Valid values:
true: Resources are replenished.
false: Resources are not replenished
HasCompleteStandbyRes.description_zh:
是否在跨可用区切换后补齐新主库资源。取值范围如下：
true：是
false：否

HotStandbyCluster.description_en:
Indicates whether the hot standby storage cluster (and Standby compute nodes) is enabled. Valid values:
StandbyClusterON: The hot standby storage cluster and Standby compute nodes are enabled.
StandbyClusterOFF: The hot standby storage cluster and Standby compute nodes are disabled
HotStandbyCluster.description_zh:
是否开启存储热备集群(和Standby计算节点)。取值范围如下：
StandbyClusterON：开启存储热备/开启存储热备和Standby计算节点。 
StandbyClusterOFF：关闭存储热备/关闭存储热备和Standby计算节点

ImciAutoIndex.description_en: The automatic IMCI-based query acceleration feature. Valid values:
ImciAutoIndex.description_zh:
自动列存索引提速功能。取值范围如下：
`ON`：开启。
`OFF`：关闭

ImperceptibleSwitch.description_en: The failover with hot replica feature. Valid values:
ImperceptibleSwitch.description_zh:
无感切换。取值范围如下：
`true`：开启。
`false`：关闭

InodeTotal.description_en: The maximum number of inodes in the file system

IsLatestVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the cluster is running the latest kernel version. Valid values:
IsLatestVersion.description_zh:
是否为最新内核版本。取值范围如下：

true：是

false：否

IsProxyLatestVersion.description_en: Indicates whether the database proxy is the latest version. Valid values:
IsProxyLatestVersion.description_zh:
是否为数据库代理最新版本，取值范围如下：

true：是
false：否

LockMode.description_zh:
锁定模式。取值范围如下： 

Unlock：未锁定。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。 
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定

MaintainTime.description_en: The maintenance window of the cluster. The time is in the `HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ` format (UTC). For example, `16:00Z-17:00Z` indicates that routine maintenance can be performed from 00:00 to 01:00 (UTC+08:00)
MaintainTime.description_zh: 集群的可维护时间段，格式为`HH:mmZ-HH:mmZ`（UTC时间）。例如`16:00Z-17:00Z`表示，0点到1点（UTC+08:00）可以进行例行维护

Orca.description_zh:
Orca功能，取值如下：

on：开启

off：关闭

PayType.description_zh:
付费类型。取值范围如下：

Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

ProvisionedIops.description_en: The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1000 × Capacity - Baseline performance}.
ProvisionedIops.description_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50000}。

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数。

ProxyCpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the database proxy

ProxyServerlessType.description_en:
The serverless type of the database proxy. Valid values:

AgileServerless: agile serverless, which indicates a serverless cluster.
SteadyServerless: steady serverless, which indicates a cluster with defined specifications (a subscription or pay-as-you-go cluster)
ProxyServerlessType.description_zh:
数据库代理Serverless类型。取值范围如下：
AgileServerless：敏态，即Serverless集群。
SteadyServerless：稳态，即固定规格集群（计费类型为包年包月或按量付费的集群）

ProxyStandardCpuCores.description_en: The number of CPU cores in the standard configuration of the database proxy
ProxyStandardCpuCores.description_zh: 数据库代理标准配置CPU核数

ProxyStatus.description_en: The status of the database proxy. Valid values:
ProxyStatus.description_zh:
数据库代理的状态。取值范围如下：

Creating：创建中
Running：运行中
Deleting：释放中
Rebooting：重启中
DBNodeCreating：正在增加节点
DBNodeDeleting：正在删除节点
ClassChanging：正在变更节点规格
NetAddressCreating：正在创建网络连接
NetAddressDeleting：正在删除网络连接
NetAddressModifying：正在修改网络连接
Deleted：已释放

ProxyType.description_en: The type of the database proxy. Valid values:
ProxyType.description_zh:
数据库代理类型，取值范围如下：

Exclusive：企业独享版
General ：企业通用版

RestoreDataPoint.description_en:
If RestoreType is RestoreByTime or RestoreByTimeOss, this value indicates the point in time to which the cluster is restored.
If RestoreType is RestoreByBackupSet or RestoreByBackupSetOss, this value indicates the ID of the backup set from which the cluster is restored.

<note>This parameter is supported only for clusters that are restored from a backup set or to a point in time after June 1, 2024.</note>
RestoreDataPoint.description_zh:
若 RestoreType 为 RestoreByTime 或 RestoreByTimeOss，该值表示恢复的时间点。
若 RestoreType 为 RestoreByBackupSet 或 RestoreByBackupSetOss，该值表示恢复所基于的备份集ID。

<note>仅2024年6月1日以后从备份集或时间点恢复的集群支持该参数</note>

RestoreType.description_en:
The cluster restoration method. Valid values:

RestoreByTime: Restores from a point in time based on a level-1 backup.
RestoreByBackupSet: Restores from a backup set based on a level-1 backup.
RestoreByTimeOss: Restores from a point in time based on a level-2 backup.
RestoreByBackupSetOss: Restores from a backup set based on a level-2 backup.
CloneFromSourceCluster: Clones from the source cluster.

<note>This parameter is supported only for clusters that are restored from a backup set or a point in time after June 1, 2024.</note>
RestoreType.description_zh:
集群恢复方式，其值可能为：

RestoreByTime：基于一级备份从时间点恢复。
RestoreByBackupSet：基于一级备份从备份集恢复。
RestoreByTimeOss：基于二级备份从时间点恢复。
RestoreByBackupSetOss：基于二级备份从备份集恢复。
CloneFromSourceCluster：从源集群克隆。

<note>仅2024年6月1日以后从备份集或时间点恢复的集群支持该参数</note>

SQLSize.description_en: The storage size of SQL statements. Unit: bytes. A value of -1 indicates that no data is available
SQLSize.description_zh: SQL的存储量，单位为Byte。若数值为-1，则表示没有数据

SearchClusterStatus.description_en: The running status of the search node

SearchCompressStorageUsed.description_en: The compressed storage data size of the search node
SearchCompressStorageUsed.description_zh:
Search节点压缩后的存储数据大小。
仅当集群开启存储压缩功能后支持返回该参数

SearchStorageUsed.description_en: The storage usage of the search node

ServerlessType.description_en:
The serverless type of the cluster. Valid values:

AgileServerless: agile serverless. This value indicates a serverless cluster.
SteadyServerless: steady serverless. This value indicates a cluster with defined specifications that has the serverless feature enabled.

This parameter is supported only for serverless clusters or clusters with defined specifications that have the serverless feature enabled
ServerlessType.description_zh:
集群Serverless类型。取值范围如下：

AgileServerless：敏态，即Serverless集群。
SteadyServerless：稳态，即开启了Serverless功能的固定规格集群。

仅在Serverless集群或开启了Serverless功能的固定规格集群，才支持该参数

SourceDBCluster.description_en:
The ID of the source cluster.
<note>This parameter is supported only for clusters restored from a backup set or point in time after June 1, 2024.</note>
SourceDBCluster.description_zh:
源集群ID。
<note>仅2024年6月1日以后从备份集或时间点恢复的集群支持该参数</note>

SourceRegionId.description_en: The region ID of the source cluster
SourceRegionId.description_zh:
源集群所处地域ID。
<note>仅源集群ID存在的情况下才可能返回。</note>

StandbyHAMode.description_en:
The cross-zone disaster recovery mode. Valid values:
ON: Cross-zone disaster recovery mode is enabled.
OFF: Cross-zone disaster recovery mode is disabled.
0: Customer drill mode
StandbyHAMode.description_zh:
跨可用容灾模式。取值范围如下：
ON：开启跨可用容灾模式。
OFF：关闭跨可用容灾模式。
0：客户演练模式

StorageMax.description_en: The maximum storage capacity for the current cluster specifications. Unit: bytes
StorageMax.description_zh: 当前集群规格的最大存储容量，单位为Byte

StoragePayType.description_en:
The billing method for storage. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
StoragePayType.description_zh:
存储计费类型。取值范围如下：

Postpaid：按容量计费（按量付费）。
Prepaid：按空间计费（包年包月）。

StorageSpace.description_en: The storage space billed by space (subscription). Unit: bytes
StorageSpace.description_zh: 按空间计费（包年包月）的存储空间。单位：Byte

StorageType.description_en: The storage type. The value is fixed as HighPerformance

StorageUsed.description_zh: 存储空间的使用量，单位为Byte

StrictConsistency.description_en: Indicates whether multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:
StrictConsistency.description_zh:
集群是否开启了多可用区数据强一致。取值范围如下：

ON：表示开启了多可用区数据强一致，适用于标准版3AZ场景。

OFF：表示未开启多可用区数据强一致

SubCategory.description_en:
The specification type of the compute node. Valid values:

Exclusive: Dedicated
General: General-purpose

This parameter is returned only for PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition clusters
SubCategory.description_zh:
计算节点的规格类型，取值范围如下：
Exclusive：独享规格
General：通用规格

仅PolarDB MySQL版且产品系列为集群版时，支持返回该参数

SupportInstantSwitchWithImci.description_en: Indicates whether the failover with hot replica feature that is compatible with IMCI is supported
SupportInstantSwitchWithImci.description_zh: 是否支持兼容列存IMCI的无感秒切功能
